notes.title: Love & Cards Early Access OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone!
Our new game "[b]Love & Cards[/b]" is now available in Early Access![/h2]

[i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017700/Love__Cards/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017700/Love__Cards/[/url][/b][/i]

Set in the same universe as OPT 1 & 2, this new game introduces you to brand-new characters and adventures on the planet New Frontier!
This game is a mix of a visual novel, a card game, a point-and-click, and a romance game! (Yes, a lot all at once!)

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44891385/7cb41f24648a4cdb680f9350fb0df1fe100cae7e.png[/img]

In this first update, which offers nearly an hour of content, you’ll get to experience all the new features we’ve added to the game: improved graphics, more animations, voice-acted dialogues, and much more advanced storytelling than before!

I wish you all an amazing time playing! Don’t hesitate to leave a positive review if you enjoyed it (it helps a lot)!
And most importantly, share your feedback with us! Our goal is to create the best game possible!

Have a great day, everyone!
Bye ~~

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44891385/ca25556b1f37de417c2f633d647560e7df71da57.png[/img]
